title: Show the basket total in pounds with two decimals on the review screen
body:
### Summary

As a customer on the review screen, I want the basket total shown in pounds with two decimals, like "£12.50".

### Completion Goal

1. [screenshot] state: `/order/review` with the seeded basket of 2 items; expected: the basket total in pounds with two decimals, in the form "£12.50"

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

the 1 criterion

### Scenario

As the seeded customer, add the 2 seeded items to the basket, open /order/review, and capture it.

### Environment

local app with the seeded synthetic customer; never production

### Checkpoints

1. The review screen shows the seeded basket's total in pounds with two decimals (criterion 1)

### Assumptions

- The seeded basket of 2 items stands for any basket.

### Provenance

Request: "Under Feature #40 (Online ordering), show the basket total on `/order/review` in pounds with two decimals, like "£12.50"."
1. stated (request): "show the basket total on `/order/review` in pounds with two decimals"; facts: route:/order/review, component:BasketSummary
